observation: ZN-E002 (ResConv + masked summary, 9 inter MLP blocks): MAPE 0.3368, RMSE 427.8, Acc@15 0.318; gradient gate FAIL only at inter_mlp.0 (55% near-zero late grads). ZN-E003 (+TCN) passed the gradient gate but was worse (MAPE 0.3635), so the temporal operator is dropped. Validation is noisy (20 cells, 46 steps/epoch).
primary_hypothesis: Reducing the post-summary MLP from 9 residual blocks to 2 (architecture.md §2.3 lightweight head) removes the weak-gradient deep stack and lowers variance, giving a passing gradient gate and MAPE <= 0.3288 or RMSE <= 406.8 vs ZN-E002.
question_inherited: Is ZN-E002's gradient-gate failure and variance caused by the over-deep 9-block head?
unresolved_from_reference: Whether a 2-block head keeps ZN-E002's accuracy while passing the gradient gate.
why_this_experiment: A2 follow-up 2 of the ResConv family (Codex ZN-E003 analysis). architecture.md §3: flat/dead deep layers -> reduce depth; §2.3 head = 1-2 layer MLP.
modification: Head only: inter_mlp 9 -> 2 MLP blocks (d_ff 64, dropout 0.1). Curve encoder, masked summary, Linear(192->64) and output head unchanged from ZN-E002.
held_constant_components: Residual Conv1D curve encoder, masked mean/last/delta summary, Linear(192->64), d_model 64, dropout 0.1, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, data.
controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE (tools/rescore.py) vs ZN-E002; gradient health per block; EOL-band MAPE/bias; pred SD and corr; params/time.
rejection_condition: Primary rule (all must hold for KEEP, else DISCARD): (MAPE <= 0.3288 OR RMSE <= 406.8) AND Acc@15 >= 0.268 AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3468 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD. Secondary: EOL-band MAPE/bias vs ZN-E002.
minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; CPMLP block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.

architecture_addendum.evidence: ZN-E002 inter_mlp.0 55% near-zero late gradients (only gate failure); architecture.md §2.3/§3
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> 2 MLP blocks [B,64] -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: unchanged from ZN-E002: per-cycle encoding; mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta last - cycle1
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15 and DB-MAPE (= MAPE, one domain) vs ZN-E002; gradient gate; EOL bands; pred SD/corr

smoke_evidence: Same variant and code path as ZN-E002 (Kaggle T4 full run) and ZN-E003S CUDA smoke; only mlp_layers changes. Local forward check: finite, padding-invariant.
